title: Which tea should we push first this spring?
why: We can run one push at a time and measure it, and each needs about two weeks before the numbers mean anything. Orders rose sharply in April last year, and April is about four weeks away.

table.caption: Last 8 weeks, per tea. Source: Northwind Tea Co. order history

evidence.label: Peak last year
evidence.value: orders doubled between March and April

options.label: Sencha green
options.note: Sells the most, but the stock lasts only 9 more weeks.

options.label: Masala chai
options.note: A steady seller with plenty of stock.

options.label: Jasmine pearls
options.note: Sells little today, so it would be the slowest to pay off.

recommend.because: It sells steadily and has 14 weeks of stock, so a push cannot empty the shelf before the peak.

if_no: If none of these fits, name the tea in the comment. We start no push until you do.
